_note: Company liveries. A livery is exactly two colours from art/config/material_palette.json painted onto the two shared company-colour materials, so one asset renders any company. V1 has one company: the livery is chosen from the company's name, deterministically and with no screen to pick paint, so a name typed twice earns the same colours in the same engine and in the next one. Names are 1850s road-name paint, not brand trade marks.
